prompt:
A full-length figure of an enemy for a mythology card game's pre-fight screen, made by hand like a 1993 fantasy game-book illustration at its very best: confident black pen-and-ink outlines, rich ink hatching, flat gouache and watercolour washes with visible brush marks, bold and colourful where the subject allows. Highly detailed, dramatic and menacing, a powerful pose full of character, facing the viewer as an opponent about to fight. The whole figure fits inside the frame with a little room around it, standing on nothing. Cut out cleanly on a fully transparent background: no ground, no scenery, no frame, no text, no glow behind it.

Subject: The Bull Demon King of Journey to the West: a huge demon king with the head of a black bull and great curved horns, burning eyes, in red-and-gold lacquered armour and a flowing cape, swinging an iron cudgel, flames curling around him. Chinese, Ming dynasty, with the brush rhythm of Chinese painting.
